name: tribe
description: Make a one-page website draft for your business in a chat, edit it, and ask Tribe Solutions to put it live.

interface.longDescription:
Tribe turns a chat into a website for a small business.

Describe your business in a few sentences: what it is called, what it offers, where it is. Tribe makes a one-page website draft from your own words and gives you a link you can open and share. Ask for changes (colours, text, services, contact buttons) and the same draft is updated. Drafts work in Azerbaijani, Russian and English.

When you are happy with the draft, you can ask Tribe Solutions, a web studio in Baku, to call or WhatsApp you within one working day to put the site live on your own domain. Nothing is bought inside ChatGPT; any work on a live site is agreed directly with Tribe.

Who it is for: owners of small businesses such as clinics, shops, salons, cafes and service companies, especially in Azerbaijan, who need a simple website quickly.

Limits: a draft is one page, built only from the facts you give (no invented reviews or numbers). Anyone with the link can open it, it is hidden from search engines, and it is deleted 45 days after the last change. Photos and online booking are not part of a draft. Tribe only asks for your phone number when you ask to be contacted.
